project_name: Renewable Energy Observatory & Interactive Education App

design_archetype.name: Technical Observatory & Clean Energy Telemetry
design_archetype.vibe: High-precision command center meets interactive scientific laboratory

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous technical padding with crisp structural borders and grid alignment.

grid_modes.mode_a_tetris: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 for feature highlights & storytelling
grid_modes.mode_b_high_density: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6 for telemetry & interactive labs

layout_and_spacing.card_padding_rule: Containers with borders MUST maintain internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent edge collision.

header.style: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 light:bg-white/80 border-b border-cyan-500/20 z-50 sticky top-0)
header.brand: Logo with glowing cyan pulsing status dot + 'HELIOS' Observatory title
header.desktop_nav: Visible links: Observatory Grid, Energy Sim, Storage Lab, Microgrid Sandbox, Global Matrix, Career Atlas, Feedback Hub
header.actions: Light/Dark theme toggle + Interactive Guided Tour CTA

footer.style: Dark structural footer with 1px top border, grid details, ASCII telemetry status, and link matrices
footer.cta: Massive 'Join the Energy Transition' bold footer banner with text-4xl responsive typography

area_1_live_observatory_grid.name: Live Grid Telemetry Observatory
area_1_live_observatory_grid.description: Real-time energy generation dashboard with live dynamic gauge charts, power flow node maps, and carbon intensity metrics.
area_1_live_observatory_grid.layout: High Density Grid (Mode B). Metric summary cards (col-span-1), telemetry chart (col-span-2 row-span-2), node feed (col-span-1 row-span-2).

area_2_energy_physics_simulator.name: Solar & Wind Physics Interactive Calculator
area_2_energy_physics_simulator.description: Educational simulator where users adjust irradiance, wind speed, panel angle, and turbine size to view immediate efficiency and MW yield outputs.
area_2_energy_physics_simulator.layout: 2-column laboratory view: Control Sliders on left (col-span-1), Visual Power Flow Output & SVG Simulation on right (col-span-2).
components: Custom styled HTML sliders with cyan track

area_3_microgrid_sandbox.name: Microgrid Resiliency Sandbox
area_3_microgrid_sandbox.description: Drag-and-build sandbox for balancing municipal load with solar arrays, battery reserves, and generator backups during grid blackouts.
area_3_microgrid_sandbox.layout: Interactive canvas grid with component inventory sidebar and dynamic stability meter.

area_4_storage_dispatch_lab.name: Energy Storage & Dispatch Lab
area_4_storage_dispatch_lab.description: Deep dive into Li-ion batteries, Pumped Hydro, and Green Hydrogen storage technologies with efficiency curves and ramp time dynamics.
area_4_storage_dispatch_lab.layout: Comparative Tabbed Cards with interactive depth charts and charging cycle animations.

area_5_global_clean_matrix.name: Global Clean Energy Matrix & Atlas
area_5_global_clean_matrix.description: Interactive map/matrix showing country-level renewable penetration rates, climate policies, and mega-project case studies.
area_5_global_clean_matrix.layout: Filterable card grid with regional search, search input, and expandable drawer details.

area_6_career_policy_explorer.name: Renewable Career & Policy Path Explorer
area_6_career_policy_explorer.description: Interactive career roadmap tool connecting engineering, environmental policy, and field installation skills to real-world impact.
area_6_career_policy_explorer.layout: Timeline / Stepper layout with skill matrix badges and compensation insights.

area_7_community_feedback_hub.name: Community Research & Feedback Hub
area_7_community_feedback_hub.description: Placeholder Google Forms interface styled inside the observatory shell for educator feedback, student submissions, and feature requests.
area_7_community_feedback_hub.layout: Centered laboratory form card with custom Google Forms embed container, progress step indicators, and submission confirmation toast.

visual_enhancers_and_motion.tracing_beam: Glowing cyan/amber border highlights on active laboratory cards
visual_enhancers_and_motion.ascii_art: [GRID: ONLINE] [TELEMETRY: OPTIMAL] status banners in mono font
visual_enhancers_and_motion.motion_rules: Smooth transitions for interactive controls. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Never use universal transition: all.
visual_enhancers_and_motion.hover_contrast_rule: Every hover state MUST explicitly define text color (e.g., hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-slate-950).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast). Never use pure un-tinted dark hexes.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute: data-testid mandatory on all interactive controls (e.g., data-testid='solar-angle-slider', data-testid='grid-region-select', data-testid='theme-toggle-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px clickable areas for mobile responsiveness.

image_urls.description: Wind turbines and solar panels generating renewable energy in a desert landscape.
Silhouette of a wind turbine against a vibrant sunset sky.
Aerial view of a vast solar panel installation amidst a hilly landscape under sunset.
Powerful hydroelectric dam nestled in a rugged mountain landscape.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 7 areas are accessible via the main navigation bar and responsive tabs/drawers.
Implement light mode and dark mode with high-contrast color variables.
Always add data-testid to buttons, sliders, tabs, selects, and inputs.
Do NOT hide header links behind desktop hamburger menu.
Use custom styled charts, sliders, and badges rather than generic standard layouts.
